name: readPNG
title: Read a bitmap image stored in the PNG format

origin.description: Read a PNG file or raw vector into a raster array.

arguments.name: source
arguments.text: File name or a raw vector of PNG bytes.

arguments.name: native
arguments.text: Return a native raster instead of an array of reals.

arguments.name: info
arguments.text: Attach bit depth, color type, resolution, gamma, and text. R.metadata is unserialized.

origin.details: Values lie between 0 and 1. One channel is a matrix. A 16-bit native raster keeps the high byte of each channel.
origin.value: An array of height, width, and channels, or a nativeRaster.
origin.example:
img <- readPNG(system.file("img", "Rlogo.png", package="png"))
cat(paste(paste(dim(img), collapse = " x "), sprintf("%.17g", sum(img))), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Read a PNG through the system libpng into a NumPy array.

arguments.name: native
arguments.text: Return the native raster integers, one image row after another.

arguments.name: info
arguments.text: Attach bit depth, color type, resolution, gamma, and text. R.metadata is unserialized.

translation.details: Values lie between 0 and 1. One channel is a matrix. A 16-bit native raster keeps the high byte of each channel.
translation.value: An array of height, width, and channels, or a native raster.
translation.example:
from png.readPNG import readPNG
img = readPNG("Rlogo.png")
print(" x ".join(str(v) for v in img.shape), format(float(img.sum()), ".17g"))
